findings.note: Observed independent fixture outcomes for pagination exhaustion, nested/mixed deduplication, interrupted scans, exact retries, verified reuse, lock/path safety and integrity-conflict preservation. New structured examples recover existing documented scenarios; tests corroborate rather than establish new product intent.

Observed exact golden cue/text/Markdown/JSON exports, Unicode/overlap preservation, timed round trips and malformed/oversized payload refusal; technical limits are not a complete external-format compliance claim.
Observed build destination/output collision preservation and exact installer-source plumbing. Stub compiler checks are explicitly distinct from real frozen/install/uninstall acceptance.

Observed metadata-only source contract, actual local HTTP track headers, exact language/track preferences, sanitized errors and installed extractor continuation shapes. Language and absent-caption examples derive from existing FR-004/005/009, not mocked success alone.

Observed native Qt event-loop, thread affinity/lifetime, settings isolation/normalization, bitrate preservation, queue stop/retry/history warnings, large result model and bounded delta-volume checks. Ordinary config/history preservation is separately measured around the full suite.
Observed explicit opt-in external media regression, with real nonempty output assertions. Its default skip is not live PASS and it does not certify a complete channel caption archive.
Observed existing bundled local Deno/Node then PATH discovery without remote component retrieval. File presence selects a candidate runtime; actual frozen execution remains independently checked.

Observed shared URL/userinfo/query/header/secret redaction before message/exception/stack handling. Existing behavior and hostile fixtures corroborate documented credential protection; no private data used as recovery evidence.

Observed real local HTTP WebM download and FFmpeg MP4 remux validated with FFprobe, isolated temporary storage and bounded server/process cleanup. No provider live acceptance inferred from this fixture.

Observed behavioral regressions for resumable request identity, strict manifests, non-overwrite, surfaced limit stops, history integrity, timed paragraph semantics, actual-file refusal, runtime enablement and privacy. Existing production constraints remain the authority.
